headline: Friday slate: ALCS Game 4 (Rays @ Guardians, Cleveland leads 2-1; weather could push it to Saturday), Friday night college football, and NHL. The Brewers swept the Dodgers and are in the World Series. The WNBA Finals start Saturday.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edges across today's card. Thursday these went 2-1. Today: a red-hot José Ramírez, a Bruins top line that's rolling, and a college underdog getting more than a field goal.

straight.reasoning: Boston is 4-1 in its last five road games and has outscored opponents 17-5 over three games since Pastrnak joined the Geekie-Zacha top line (14 points, 5 goals). Bruins goalies are at .920 and the team allows 2.14 goals a game. Anaheim is banged up up front and has lost three of four at home. SportsBettingDime's pick, and Covers also targets the Boston top line. Price is an estimate from a 52% market; playable to -125.

Washington is +5 in turnovers against Purdue's even margin, and 3.5 gets you past a field-goal finish. SportsBettingDime's pick. Purdue's offense (31.8 points a game, 93% red zone) is the risk. Playable to +3; skip at +2.5.

props.pick: José Ramírez OVER 1.5 hits + runs + RBIs
props.reasoning: He's 11-for-30 (.367) with a 1.124 OPS this postseason, has gone over this line in five of his last six games, and is 6-for-12 against the Rays. A prop doesn't depend on the bullpen-game chaos that splits the side and total. SI's best prop. Playable to -110.

sections.label: Baseball
sections.slate: ALCS Game 4: Rays @ Guardians, 5:00 PM PT on TBS. Cleveland leads 2-1. Nick Martinez (13 scoreless innings vs Cleveland this season, but shaky lately) against a Guardians bullpen game. Pick'em on the moneyline, total 6.5. SI likes the Over and TheSpread likes the Under and Cleveland, so we pass on both. The Brewers swept the Dodgers and await the AL winner in the World Series.

props.pick: José Ramírez OVER 1.5 hits + runs + RBIs
props.reasoning: .367 this postseason, over this line in five of six, and 6-for-12 against Tampa. Playable to -110.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Friday night college football: Memphis vs Tulane (4:30 PM PT), Washington @ Purdue and Appalachian State @ Coastal Carolina (5:00). Sources split on App State-Coastal, so we skip it. Memphis is -270 to win, too expensive alone.

straight.reasoning: A +5 turnover margin and more than a field goal of cushion. Skip at +2.5.

sections.label: Hockey
sections.slate: Penguins @ Avalanche (6:00 PM PT) and Bruins @ Ducks (7:00) headline. Colorado is playing its third game in four nights and Blackwood is at .879.

straight.reasoning: 4-1 in the last five on the road, a top line that's outscoring teams 17-5 over three games, and a banged-up Anaheim. Playable to -125.

Colorado is 2-4 in its last six as a home favorite, its goalies are at .881, and it's on its third game in four nights. Pittsburgh is 3-1 in its last four against winning teams. SportsBettingDime's pick. Price is an estimate from a 35% market; skip below +160.

props.reasoning: He's playing 20+ minutes with MacKinnon and has a goal and an assist in his last three games. Covers rates it about 57% at even money. Quarter unit, since he's missed for us before. Playable to -115.
